becoder.002: The path to clangd executable. BeCoder for Windows always uses its bundled clangd.
becoder.003: Allows the path to be a script. Ignored by BeCoder for Windows.
becoder.004: Arguments for clangd server. BeCoder for Windows uses managed arguments.
becoder.006: Extra clang flags used to parse files. BeCoder for Windows uses managed bundled-toolchain flags.
becoder.007: Auto restart clangd (up to 4 times) if it crashes.
becoder.008: Check for language server updates on startup. BeCoder for Windows updates clangd only with its bundled toolchain.
becoder.010: Enable code completion provided by the language server
becoder.011: Enable hovers provided by the language server
